description: an extruded D, a 2 × 2 square with a half circle of radius 1 on its x = 2 side, 1 high, and two edges asked of one fillet at r 0.25: the crease along the top of its flat x = 0 side, and the vertical edge where the flat side y = −1 meets the round end, a tangent dihedral. Open CASCADE's MakeFillet leaves the tangent edge out without a word (ChFi3d_FilBuilder::Add, ADR-0070; Contour of it is 0) and rounds the crease alone, whose volume is the closed form below: the removed corner (1 − π/4) r² along its length 2. Arris refuses the tangent edge as TangentChain, since no rolling ball blends it
